# SEOAcademys
> Free SEO tools platform used by 2.4M+ marketers. 37 professional-grade tools for AI search optimization, rank tracking, schema generation, and technical SEO — all free, no signup.

## Tools

### AI Search & GEO
- [AI Citation Audit](https://seoacademys.com/tools/ai-citation-audit): Checks if your website is cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Scans 47 GEO signals in real-time.
- [GEO Market Intelligence](https://seoacademys.com/tools/geo-tracker): Live market data on what AI engines cite most across Tech, Finance, Health, SaaS industries.
- [Content Readiness Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/content-checker): AI extraction quality scoring with sentence-by-sentence highlighting for LLM citability.
- [Schema & llms.txt Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-generator): Generates production-ready JSON-LD and llms.txt files instantly.

### SEO Audit
- [Full SEO Audit](https://seoacademys.com/tools/seo-audit): Live on-page SEO audit checking 47 signals including title, meta, headings, Core Web Vitals, schema, and mobile-friendliness.
- [Meta Tag Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/meta-tag-checker): Inspects every meta tag live — title length, description, OG tags, Twitter cards.
- [Heading Structure](https://seoacademys.com/tools/heading-checker): Visualizes H1-H6 outline to identify heading hierarchy issues.
- [Open Graph Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/og-checker): Live Facebook/LinkedIn share preview with og:* validation.
- [Twitter Card Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/twitter-card-checker): Live X (Twitter) share preview with twitter:* validation.
- [Canonical URL Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/canonical-checker): Validates rel=canonical and detects cross-domain conflicts.
- [Robots.txt Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/robots-checker): Validates robots.txt syntax and checks AI crawler directives (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot).
- [Sitemap Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/sitemap-checker): Validates XML sitemap structure and URL coverage.
- [Mobile-Friendly Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/mobile-checker): Tests mobile usability and Core Web Vitals.
- [SSL Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/ssl-checker): Verifies SSL certificate validity and HTTPS configuration.

### Website Analysis
- [Tech Detector](https://seoacademys.com/tools/tech-detector): Detects CMS, framework, CDN and analytics from any live URL.
- [Redirect Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/redirect-checker): Traces redirect chains up to 8 hops with per-hop status.
- [HTTP Headers Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/http-headers): Inspects every response header for cache, security and compression.
- [Page Size Analyzer](https://seoacademys.com/tools/page-size): Page weight + asset breakdown for Core Web Vitals.

### Schema & Structured Data
- [Schema Validator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-validator): Validates JSON-LD schema markup against Schema.org standards.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/faq-schema): Generates FAQ schema for Google rich results.
- [Product Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/product-schema): Creates Product schema with price, availability, and reviews.
- [Article Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/article-schema): Generates Article/BlogPosting schema.
- [Breadcrumb Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/breadcrumb-schema): Creates BreadcrumbList schema for site navigation.

### Content SEO
- [Keyword Density](https://seoacademys.com/tools/keyword-density): Analyzes keyword distribution and LSI keyword coverage.
- [Readability](https://seoacademys.com/tools/readability): Flesch-Kincaid score and readability analysis.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://seoacademys.com/tools/word-counter): Live word, character, sentence and reading-time counter.
- [Link Analyzer](https://seoacademys.com/tools/link-analyzer): Audits internal/external link distribution.
- [Broken Link Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/broken-links): Finds all broken links on a page in real-time.
- [Image SEO Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/image-seo): Checks alt text, file names, and image optimization.

### Performance
- [HTML Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/html-minifier): Live HTML compression with byte-saving stats.
- [CSS Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/css-minifier): Live CSS compression with byte-saving stats.
- [JS Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/js-minifier): Live JavaScript compression with byte-saving stats.

### Research
- [Keyword Research](https://seoacademys.com/tools/keyword-research): Free keyword research with volume and difficulty estimates.
- [SERP Preview](https://seoacademys.com/tools/serp-preview): Previews how your page appears in Google search results.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/meta-generator): SEO / OG / Twitter meta builder with live HTML preview.
- [Robots.txt Builder](https://seoacademys.com/tools/robots-txt): Visual robots.txt builder with AI-crawler presets.
- [Backlink Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/backlink-checker): Analyzes backlink profile and domain authority signals.
